review.note: Fresh registry discovery covers every direct Python build/runtime/development and Node dependency, including candidates outside declared upper bounds. Compared with the committed Ingest 0.27.0 receipt, third-party changes are Hypothesis 6.168.0 to 6.168.1 and Ruff 0.16.8 to 0.16.9; all other third-party latest candidates are identical, so their prior identical-version upstream reviews carry forward. Reviewed Hypothesis official changelog (https://hypothesis.readthedocs.io/en/latest/changelog.html#v6-168-1): this patch adds Linux s390x manylinux and i686 musllinux abi3 wheels. Reviewed Ruff official release notes (https://github.com/astral-sh/ruff/releases/tag/0.16.9): bugbear keyword-argument false-positive fixes affect enabled B rules; the other changes concern unselected/preview rules, Python 3.15 fixes and documentation. Installed both new candidates in the repository CPython 3.14.1 environment. Ruff 0.16.9 readonly lint passed; tests/test_vnext_incremental_state_machine.py passed all 3 tests using Hypothesis 6.168.1; tests/test_package.py passed all 3 package-boundary tests. Public h2hdb advanced from 0.40.0 to 0.42.0 and now satisfies the declared h2hdb>=0.41.0,<0.43.0 range. Core 0.42.0 retires one-time schema-7 checkout conversion tooling and its private offline audit writer; the schema-8 public runtime facades consumed by Ingest are retained. The local Core source change 09ff04b and explicit Core 0.42.0 wheel were reviewed rather than relying on a fixed sibling discovery path. The Ingest environment uses /private/tmp/h2hdb-retired-upgrade-0420-wheels/h2hdb-0.42.0-py3-none-any.whl; after refreshing editable Ingest metadata to 0.28.0, uv pip check passed all 44 installed packages. Every discovered candidate is within its declared bounds and all Python candidates report Python 3.14-compatible distributions. Ingest 0.28.0 is a compatibility-lane release for journal v5 and source page observation timing changes; this dependency review neither supplies a runtime legacy-format fallback nor substitutes for the separately required offline journal conversion evidence. Full exact-tree release checks, manual performance/MariaDB tests and final wheel verification are separate from this dependency receipt.
